name: prompt-input
title: Prompt input
description: A chat composer on the ui-sdk Textarea and FileInput parts. Enter sends on desktop when ready and adds a line on touch-only devices or while pending. Files attach by drop, paste, or the picker.

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { computed, provide, ref } from "vue";
import { FileInput, FileInputDropzone } from "@ui-sdk/vue/file-input";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { PromptInputMessage } from "./utils";
import { promptInputKey } from "./utils";

const props = defineProps<{
  pending?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  accept?: string | string[];
  maxFiles?: number;
  maxSize?: number;
  class?: HTMLAttributes["class"];
}>();
const text = defineModel<string>({ default: "" });
const files = defineModel<File[]>("files", { default: () => [] });
const emit = defineEmits<{ submit: [message: PromptInputMessage]; stop: [] }>();

const form = ref<HTMLFormElement>();
const pending = computed(() => props.pending);
const canSubmit = computed(() => !props.disabled && (text.value.trim() !== "" || files.value.length > 0));
const textarea = () => form.value?.querySelector("textarea") ?? null;

function onSubmit() {
  if (props.pending || !canSubmit.value) return;
  emit("submit", { text: text.value, files: [...files.value] });
  text.value = "";
  files.value = [];
}

provide(promptInputKey, { text, files, pending, canSubmit, submit: () => form.value?.requestSubmit(), stop: () => emit("stop"), textarea });
</script>

<template>
  <form ref="form" data-slot="prompt-input" :class="cn('w-full', props.class)" @submit.prevent="onSubmit">
    <FileInput v-model:value="files" multiple :accept="props.accept" :max-files="props.maxFiles" :max-size="props.maxSize" :disabled="props.disabled">
      <FileInputDropzone
        :paste-target="textarea"
        class="flex flex-col rounded-xl border border-input bg-background transition-[border-color,box-shadow] duration-150 has-[textarea:focus-visible]:border-ring has-[textarea:focus-visible]:ring-1 has-[textarea:focus-visible]:ring-ring has-[textarea:focus-visible]:ring-inset data-drag-accept:border-ring data-drag-accept:bg-accent/40 data-drag-reject:border-destructive motion-reduce:transition-none"
      >
        <slot />
      </FileInputDropzone>
    </FileInput>
  </form>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { PaperclipIcon } from "@lucide/vue";
import { FileInputTrigger } from "@ui-sdk/vue/file-input";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ label?: string; class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), { label: "Attach files" });
</script>

<template>
  <FileInputTrigger :aria-label="props.label" :class="cn(buttonVariants({ variant: 'ghost', size: 'icon-sm' }), 'text-muted-foreground', props.class)">
    <slot><PaperclipIcon aria-hidden="true" /></slot>
  </FileInputTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { FileInputItem, FileInputList } from "@ui-sdk/vue/file-input";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import PromptInputAttachment from "./PromptInputAttachment.vue";
import { usePromptInput } from "./utils";

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ label?: string; class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), { label: "Attachments" });
const { files } = usePromptInput();
</script>

<template>
  <FileInputList
    v-show="files.length > 0"
    :aria-label="props.label"
    :class="cn('m-0 flex list-none gap-2 overflow-x-auto p-2 pb-0', props.class)"
  >
    <FileInputItem
      v-slot="{ state }"
      data-focus-inset=""
      class="flex max-w-56 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/60 p-1 pe-1.5 outline-none data-highlighted:bg-muted"
    >
      <slot :file="state.file">
        <PromptInputAttachment :file="state.file" />
      </slot>
    </FileInputItem>
  </FileInputList>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { ArrowUpIcon, SquareIcon } from "@lucide/vue";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { usePromptInput } from "./utils";

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ label?: string; stopLabel?: string; class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), {
  label: "Send",
  stopLabel: "Stop",
});
const { pending, canSubmit, stop } = usePromptInput();
</script>

<template>
  <button
    :type="pending ? 'button' : 'submit'"
    data-slot="prompt-input-submit"
    :data-pending="pending ? '' : undefined"
    :aria-label="pending ? props.stopLabel : props.label"
    :disabled="!pending && !canSubmit"
    :class="cn(buttonVariants({ size: 'icon-sm' }), 'ms-auto', props.class)"
    @click="pending && stop()"
  >
    <SquareIcon v-if="pending" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 fill-current" />
    <ArrowUpIcon v-else aria-hidden="true" />
  </button>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue";
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from "vue";
import { Textarea } from "@ui-sdk/vue/textarea";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { usePromptInput } from "./utils";

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ placeholder?: string; label?: string; class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>(), {
  placeholder: "Send a message",
  label: "Message",
});
const { text, pending, submit } = usePromptInput();
const touchOnly = ref(false);
const enterSends = computed(() => !pending.value && !touchOnly.value);
let coarsePointer: MediaQueryList | undefined;
let finePointer: MediaQueryList | undefined;

function updateTouchOnly() {
  touchOnly.value = coarsePointer?.matches === true && finePointer?.matches === false;
}

onMounted(() => {
  coarsePointer = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)");
  finePointer = window.matchMedia("(any-pointer: fine)");
  updateTouchOnly();
  coarsePointer.addEventListener("change", updateTouchOnly);
  finePointer.addEventListener("change", updateTouchOnly);
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  coarsePointer?.removeEventListener("change", updateTouchOnly);
  finePointer?.removeEventListener("change", updateTouchOnly);
});

function onKeydown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (!enterSends.value || event.key !== "Enter" || event.shiftKey || event.altKey || event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.isComposing) return;
  event.preventDefault();
  submit();
}
</script>

<template>
  <Textarea
    v-model:value="text"
    auto-resize
    :placeholder="props.placeholder"
    :aria-label="props.label"
    :enterkeyhint="enterSends ? 'send' : 'enter'"
    :class="cn('max-h-48 min-h-12 w-full resize-none border-0 bg-transparent px-3 pt-3 pb-1 text-base text-foreground outline-none pointer-fine:text-sm placeholder:text-ui-text-dimmed', props.class)"
    @keydown="onKeydown"
  />
</template>
